newsitem.title: BELARUS: Belarus gas pipeline fire seen not hurting clients.
newsitem.headline: Belarus gas pipeline fire seen not hurting clients.

text.p: Russian gas supplies to Poland and Ukraine should not be interrupted by an accident at the Belarussian section of the pipeline which was still shut on Thursday following a fire on April 30, an energy official said.
"We have two alternative routes -- the Poles and the Ukrainians and our own customers should not worry," the duty officer at Beltransgaz state energy body, told Reuters.
"The fire was extinguished today and repair works are going on. I think we need one day to complete them," he said, adding that the pipeline should be reopened then.
The accident happened in a field about 60 km (40 miles) south of the capital Minsk.
There were no indications of what caused the fire and estimates of the damage, the duty officer said, though he added that for the past several years the pipe had not been working at full capacity.
